title: Policy-aware universal-pusher: stop workspace-sync from resurrecting files prune-integrity.js deleted (break the prune ↔ workspace-sync re-add loop)
problem_statement: prune-integrity.js (PROP-051 Workstream C) deletes aged monitor/integrity/ per-run artifacts from git daily at ~08:06Z. FUSE cannot unlink(), so the FUSE copies of every pruned file persist forever. workspace-sync's hourly universal-pusher saw 'file in FUSE, absent in git' in smart_copy's dst-absent branch and unconditionally cp'd the file back — resurrecting it within ~16-60 min of every prune. Retention never converged: monitor/integrity/ held 892+ top-level files vs the ~20-170 the policy targets; archive JSONLs accreted duplicate records every cycle; prune+pusher churned ~1,000-1,500 file ops/day (06-01=1157, 06-02=633, 06-03=1291, 06-04=1348, 06-05=732, 06-06=1440 staged deletes). Smoking gun: prune commit b8e3c000 (2026-06-06T08:06:24Z, 1,440 deletions) → workspace-sync commit 73f18678 (08:22:18Z) re-added 710 workspace-sync-runs/ files, and commit fc74aae (09:08:36Z) re-added the top-level integrity artifacts including all 23 narrative-cite-audit-2026-05-17T*.json files (42 days old, policy keeps last 7). Same defect family as the unactioned DIRECTIVE-20260521-002: the pusher cannot distinguish 'workflow-deleted, do not rescue' from 'agent-authored, please rescue'.

table.note: keep_last_n-only policy; daily cadence ~7d, filter uses 2x margin so it never blocks a file prune would keep

evidence.universal_pusher_decision_point: monitor/prompts/workspace-sync.md smart_copy(): the `if [ ! -f "$dst" ]; then cp ...` dst-absent branch is the exact resurrect point. Once re-added, subsequent cycles no-op via the cmp -s identity check, so the loop is purely prune-delete → dst-absent-rescue.

proposed_fix.design: Operator-pre-approved option (a): make the universal-pusher policy-aware. New bash function is_prune_expired() inline in workspace-sync.md (policies table mirrored from prune-integrity.js — no safe require() path exists because prune-integrity.js executes top-level CLI code on import). The dst-absent branch of smart_copy calls it before cp: if the dst path matches a prune category AND its filename-embedded date is strictly older than the category's retention window (+1 day slack for day-granular parsing), the push is skipped and logged to workspace-sync-skips.jsonl with reason 'older-than-prune-retention'.
proposed_fix.why_inline_not_import: prune-integrity.js has no module.exports and runs its main flow at top level (incl. process.exit paths); require() would execute a prune. Modifying it is barred by the directive's non-goals. Inline table + a mirror-maintenance comment is the cleaner LOC and the safer runtime.
conservatism: Fail-open: unparseable filenames and paths outside the 9 categories fall through to the normal rescue. data/wins.json, open-issues.json, priority-queue.json etc. are untouched.
Day-granular date parse adds +1 day slack: files are skipped only STRICTLY past the window, so the filter never blocks a file prune would keep on days-based policies.

narrative-cite-audit (keep_last_n-only, no retention_days) uses a derived 14d window (2x the 7-file daily-cadence floor). Files aged 7-14d may still round-trip once more (~7 files/day residual churn vs ~1,400 before, >99% reduction) and converge at 14d.

Three FATAL self-tests guard the function (42d-old canary must skip; today-dated file must push; open-issues.json must never match), mirroring the existing NEVER_PUSH/GIT_APPEND_ONLY self-test pattern.
proposed_fix.additional_hardening: Explicit `sync_glob monitor/integrity/workspace-sync-runs '*.json'` added so the subdir routes through the sanctioned, filtered smart_copy path. The 710-file re-add in 73f18678 had NO sanctioned sync_glob — the Haiku agent improvised a recursive copy. Giving it the explicit, filtered path channels it away from improvisation (same skip-by-omission psychology as PROP-066).

files_touched: monitor/prompts/workspace-sync.md (+80 lines: is_prune_expired() + self-tests; 4-line guard in smart_copy dst-absent branch; explicit workspace-sync-runs sync_glob; skip-type explainer)
verification_pattern: grep -c 'is_prune_expired' monitor/prompts/workspace-sync.md  # expect >=8 (def + 3 self-tests x2 lines + smart_copy call). Simulation: source the function from the prompt, run against all monitor/integrity/narrative-cite-audit-2026-05-17T*.json paths — every one must return expired. Negative: open-issues.json, data/wins.json, today-dated audit, 3d-old verify-pending-run, 40d non-ff-abort (90d window) must all return not-expired.

verification_results.workspace_sync_runs_sample: run-2026-04-26T17-05-12Z.json + run-2026-04-26T18-05-21Z.json (both re-added in 73f18678) → SKIP; 2d-old run report → PUSH
verification_results.negative_controls: open-issues.json, data/wins.json, today-dated narrative-cite-audit, 3d-old verify-pending-run, alerts.txt, analyst expansion, 10d-old abort sentinel (30d window), 40d-old non-ff-abort (90d window) → all PUSH
verification_results.pattern_variants: 20d undashed-legacy push-failure (-YYYYMMDDTHHMMSS) → SKIP (parser fallback works); garbage filename → PUSH (fail-open)
verification_results.self_test_block: executes clean (exit 0) when sourced exactly as the agent will run it

example_skip_jsonl_record.reason: older-than-prune-retention; pruned artifact, do not resurrect

post_deployment_plan.canary_expectation: Today's prune fires ~08:06Z and will delete the (re-resurrected) aged artifacts again. The 09:0xZ workspace-sync cycle must NOT re-add any file older than its category window — specifically, zero narrative-cite-audit-2026-05-17T*.json files on origin/main after the 09:0xZ cycle, and workspace-sync-skips.jsonl should show 'older-than-prune-retention' records instead. If even ONE pruned file resurrects, the filter has a hole → immediate amendment.
post_deployment_plan.monitor: operator watches the 09:0xZ cycle (per DIRECTIVE-20260607-001 Step 9); tinker's next daily run greps workspace-sync-skips.jsonl for the new reason string and re-checks origin/main for the canary set
post_deployment_plan.convergence: with the loop broken, normal daily prune cycles drain the ~6-week backlog within 5-7 days (no retroactive mass-delete — explicitly out of scope per directive non-goals)

cross_references.DIRECTIVE-20260521-002: Same defect family (audit-files no-round-trip). Its surface — audit files that write to git but don't round-trip to FUSE — remains UNACTIONED and is NOT in scope here; needs its own proposal (different file shapes, multiple-write patterns).
cross_references.PROP-077_PROP-078: Parallel work on FUSE-revert race; NOT superseded — different surface (recent-commit guard vs prune-retention filter).
cross_references.PROP-066: Helper-extraction precedent consulted; inline bash chosen here instead because the filter lives INSIDE smart_copy which the agent already executes verbatim as one block — no new step exists for the LLM to skip.

non_goals_honored: no deny-list file (option b rejected per operator decision)
filter scoped to the 9 prune categories only
no retroactive cleanup of accumulated files
